entities.summary: Roberto Tomás Morales Ojeda is a Cuban physician and politician who served as a Vice President of Cuba. He is a member of the Politburo of the Communist Party of Cuba (PCC) and, between 2010 and 2018, served in the Council of Ministers as Minister of Public Health. Currently, he is the secretary of organization of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba.
